items.description: GET / serves an HTML page with a numeric input, source and destination unit selectors, submit button, result and visible error feedback.
POST /api/convert accepts JSON {"value":number,"from":"C"|"F"|"K","to":"C"|"F"|"K"} and returns 200 JSON {"value":number,"unit":destination unit} without integer rounding.
Conversion formulas C = (F-32)*5/9 and K = C+273.15; same-unit conversion preserves the value; negative C/F valid above absolute zero.

Reject missing fields, nonnumeric, booleans, unsupported units, malformed JSON, and below-absolute-zero (even same-unit) with HTTP 400 and JSON {"error": nonempty}; boundary -273.15 C / -459.67 F / 0 K with float tolerance.
Conversion logic separated from HTTP handling and testable without a server; npm test runs meaningful tests; npm run build checks source syntax.
npm start starts server on process.env.PORT default 3000; no external runtime services; install/start/test instructions and limitations documented.
Component interaction: User → UI (enter temp/units) → HTTP (POST /api/convert) → Convert (validate/convert) → HTTP (result/error) → UI (JSON 200 or 400).
